_comment: THE MANDATE — the single source of truth for what this desk is allowed to be. The config-drift sentinel compares the live config against this file every heartbeat; any divergence pages. Changing a value here IS the change-control act: it must be committed to git with a reason, which is what makes drift auditable. The desk's three recorded loss modes were all silent config drift.

delegation.meaning: The operator (Claude) may make and execute desk decisions on TESTNET without per-decision approval, including governance rulings recorded below, PROVIDED every ruling is written to git before it takes effect.
never_delegated: anything touching MAINNET or real funds — always the owner
removing or weakening the testnet lock in tradeGuard
editing ratified study thresholds after a result exists
re-arming autoTradeSignal outside the ratified GO process

autotrade_command_door.question: After the directional line closed (H-AUTO-1), may office agents still open trades via the agent-invoked `autotrade` command?
autotrade_command_door.ruling: OPEN, as the Practice-Trade Layer the owner endorsed on 21 Jul ('แบบนี้แหละที่ต้องการ') — testnet practice within the caps below is training, not edge-seeking. The caps in this file bind it; drift pages.
autotrade_command_door.note: The 2026-07-27 XRPUSDT trade (-$0.06, scratch fee-bleed) was within mandate and is the motivating example for the BE-buffer fix.

xsec_momentum_class.question: Is cross-sectional beta-netted momentum a new hypothesis class, or directional TA in new clothing?
xsec_momentum_class.ruling: NEW CLASS (it nets market direction; the closed line predicted direction), BUT any test must be pre-registered single-spec (k=60 only), multiplicity-adjusted for the 4-k peek already on the ledger (look #14), and must state universe survivorship as a known optimistic bias. NOT scheduled — parked until a survivorship-corrected universe exists. → RESOLVED 2026-07-27: the survivorship-corrected universe was built (look #18, one pre-registered shot) and the class FAILED every gate — PIT net t=-0.16 vs survivor t=1.47; the entire apparent edge was survivorship bias. CLASS CLOSED.

reopen_precommit_H_AUTO_1.commitment: Option (a): the fixed-exit variant of H-AUTO-1 runs EXACTLY ONCE, pre-registered as look #17 (H-AUTO-1-R1), same signals pipeline, same ratified gates, charged to the look ledger. No second variant, no parameter exploration, regardless of how close the result lands to zero.
reopen_precommit_H_AUTO_1.sober_prior: Even perfect cost recovery lands near +0.08R gross at t~1.6 — below every gate. The expected outcome is a cleaner NO-GO, not a GO.

sizing_coherence_2026_07_27.question: Owner observed position sizes feel fearfully small. Is that caution or a defect?
sizing_coherence_2026_07_27.finding: A defect, measured: riskPct 0.5% intends $25 risk/trade, but maxNotionalPct 1 ($50 cap) clamped EVERY one of 987 replayed trades to ~$0.33-0.70 actual risk — 1/50th of stated intent. The two knobs were fighting; the cap always won.
sizing_coherence_2026_07_27.ruling: Make sizing RISK-led: maxNotionalPct 1 -> 40 so the 0.5% risk sizing actually binds for normal stops (1.39% median stop -> ~$1,800 notional, $25 risk), while the cap still protects against tight-stop blowups (a 0.5% stop caps at $2,000 notional = $10 risk, not $25). At maxLeverage 3 the margin for a full-size position is ~$667 = 13% of equity, well inside marginCapPct 80.
sizing_coherence_2026_07_27.frequency_unchanged: Trade FREQUENCY stays capped (3/day, grade A, regimeGate) — measured: every no-edge trade pays 0.13-0.24R in costs; more frequency is faster bleed, not more opportunity.
sizing_coherence_2026_07_27.cost_floor: New guard minStopPct 0.6%: entries whose stop is tighter are blocked because cost-in-R = 0.18/stop% exceeds 0.30R — unwinnable geometry. Yesterday's XRPUSDT practice trade (0.27% stop = 0.67R cost) would have been blocked.

sizing_at_go_ladder.question: Owner's real fear: when a validated entry finally arrives, will the desk size it too small?
sizing_at_go_ladder.policy: Pre-written so size follows evidence, not mood: when a strategy passes the ratified GO + 30-day shadow, live sizing starts at 1/4 of study sizing for the first 30 trades; scales to 1/2 if realized expectancy is within 1 SE of backtest; full size after 60 trades still tracking. Any deviation from this ladder is a mandate change requiring a committed reason. Scaling DOWN on divergence is automatic; scaling UP is never automatic.

showcase_grade_a_sizing_2026_07_27.question: Owner wants to see one THICK profitable trade. Can the desk deliver that honestly?
showcase_grade_a_sizing_2026_07_27.ruling: On TESTNET, yes — as an experience, not as evidence. Grade-A practice trades may size at the full grade-A risk ceiling (riskPctMaxGradeA 2% = $100 risk) via a grade-aware notional cap maxNotionalPctGradeA 150 (grade B/C stay at 40). The runner-friendly exits already in place (no fixed target, trail 1.5%) are what make a winner FAT when it wins: +5R = +$500 on one trade.
showcase_grade_a_sizing_2026_07_27.honest_arithmetic_stated_up_front: The signal has measured expectancy -0.19R, so at $100 risk the AVERAGE grade-A practice trade costs ~$19. A thick winner, when it comes, is luck wearing a seatbelt — recorded here so nobody later mistakes one green trade for edge.
showcase_grade_a_sizing_2026_07_27.guard_interactions: Margin for one full-size grade-A ($7,500 notional at 3x) = $2,500 = 50% of equity, inside marginCapPct 80. A SECOND full-size same-direction trade would breach the margin cap and is blocked — so at most one thick position plus one smaller. dailyLossPct 10% = 5 full grade-A losses. HWM ladder unchanged: 4% DD kills autoTrade regardless.

deep_stops_2026_07_27.question: Owner asks for deeper stop losses. Sound?
deep_stops_2026_07_27.ruling: Yes — it is the measured cost lever, and with risk-led sizing a deeper stop does NOT add risk: dollar risk stays at the grade ceiling while the position shrinks. Cost-in-R = 0.18/stop%: at 1.4% (old median) 0.13R, at 3% it halves to 0.06R, funding on multi-day holds ~0.006R/day (negligible at current rates), margin drops 48%->22%. Practice guidance: place stops at 1h STRUCTURE (deeper swing low - 0.3 ATR), preferred width 2-4%. Cost floor minStopPct raised 0.6 -> 1.0: below 1% the round trip alone eats >=0.18R and the desk has measured what that does.
deep_stops_2026_07_27.tradeoff_stated: Slower trades: breakeven triggers at +1R = +stop% of price, so a 3% stop means the runner must move +3% before the stop moves up — holds measured in days. Fewer trades per week. That is the deal being chosen: pay less per attempt, wait longer per attempt.
deep_stops_2026_07_27.explicitly_not_done: NO backtest of deeper stops on the closed directional line — stopMult tuning is named in the reopen rules as forbidden retuning. This ruling is posted-price arithmetic applied to the practice layer, not signal research.

full_throttle_2026_07_27.question: Owner said 'เดินหน้าใส่เต็มเหนี่ยวไปเลย' (full throttle). What does that authorize?
full_throttle_2026_07_27.ruling: Full throttle = REACTION SPEED, not switch-flipping. A grade-A signal now triggers the practice agent within seconds (practiceNudge) instead of waiting up to 30 minutes for the polling job. The agent still decides, every guard still binds, sizing is already at the grade-A ceiling ($100 risk, deep stops). What 'full throttle' does NOT reopen: autoTradeSignal stays never-delegated (measured -0.19R, owner-closed), caps stay pinned, and the HWM ladder stays armed.
full_throttle_2026_07_27.speed_limit_stated: At $100/trade the 4% HWM rung = $200 = TWO consecutive full losses stands the desk down (autoTrade off, manual re-arm). That is the seatbelt working, not a bug — recorded here so the stand-down does not surprise anyone mid-excitement.
full_throttle_2026_07_27.nudge_rate_limit: Piggybacks the existing per-symbol signal dedup (1h TTL) — at most one nudge per symbol+grade+dir per hour, grade A only, and only when the regime gate direction matches (no nudging shorts in longOnly).
